title: MIUI 11.0.2.0.QCNMIXM completely breaks xdrip
body: After downloading the newest MIUI version yesterday on my redmi 8, I am unable to connect to my transmitter, I have tried enabling and disabling every single option but have found no way to fix it, it only connects about once an hour if I keep restarting the collector and forgetting the transmitter. I will be downgrading to the previous miui version and highly discourage anyone to update to 11.0.2.0

comments.body:
This looks strange, I use xDrip plus latest ni9ghtly with Xiaomi Redmi Note 7 and smartband Mi Band 4. Just yesterday I installed the MIUI Global 11.0.1, and I had absolutely no problem, even with the smartband.
Before istalling the previous MIUI, I suggest you to try to change some xDrip parameters to see if anything changes. Good luck!
Bye.  Andrea    :-)

Hey, my issue is with 11.0.2 and not 11.0.1, and I also tried switching on or off pretty much every option and also checked the events log but didn't see anything out of the ordinary there, I am currently running the latest alpha build and had no problems until yesterday just after updating
Is there something in the logs? Does it work now?

I have started using the patched G6 app now since I couldn't get it to
work, and I do not know if it's still broken.
